title: Non-cryptographic PRNG (random.choice) used to generate password hash salt
detail: _generate_salt() at lines 612-619 builds a 16-character salt using random.choice() from Python's random module, which uses the Mersenne Twister PRNG — not suitable for security-sensitive operations. This salt is passed directly to secretutils.crypt_password() at line 645 to hash the admin password with the MD5-crypt or DES-crypt algorithm. An attacker with knowledge of the PRNG state could predict the salt, reducing the cost of offline dictionary attacks against stored password hashes. The OpenStack-approved pattern for security-sensitive randomness is secrets.choice() or os.urandom().
